status_at_creation: Written before new spectral measurements or functional evaluations
sources: Saved phase-6 initializations and selected 1800-update checkpoints
global_waveform: Block-major, alphabetically ordered parameter families, C-order tensor flattening. Compare original 30 blocks, retained/interpolated 28-block initial/final weights, and their endpoint updates. Embedding/head/final norm excluded.
global_recursion: Disjoint binary frequency partitions through level 6 (64 leaves), all bins preserved. Four/eight component reconstructions and a fixed excerpt demonstrate additive decomposition. Frequency subdivision is distinct from repeated forward FFTs.
local_transform: Each of the 42 trained projection matrices: orthonormal real FFT along its column axis, rows grouped in contiguous groups of 32. Sixteen frequency bands partition positive interior bins. DC and Nyquist always retained; two RMSNorm vectors per changed block retained in full for spectral-mask arms.
mask_budget: Choose 4 of 16 frequency bands per 32-row region, approximately 25% of real spectral degrees of freedom; report actual counts including endpoints and norms.
mask_selection: Low-quarter, high-quarter, fixed-random-quarter, highest-update-energy-quarter, and highest predicted descent-quarter. Descent score is minus the inner product between initial-model KL gradient and the already learned update in each spectral region. Gradient uses only first 8 phase-6 training windows.

controls.random_norm_matched: Same random spectral mask, per-matrix update norm matched to gradient-selected update; same full norm updates.
controls.random_spatial: Fixed random individual-weight mask with exactly the gradient mask's real degrees-of-freedom count per matrix; same norm updates.
controls.gradient_shift_one: Cyclically shift each row of the gradient-selected matrix update by one column; identical Fourier magnitudes and update norms, different phase. Norm vectors unchanged.

depth_transfer_26: Initial, full_update, gradient_quarter, random_quarter. Keep only endpoints from each edited triplet: original blocks 4 and 7, 12 and 15. Unit residual scaling. Direct transfer of the 28-block update; no 26-block training, curve resampling or weight realignment.
evaluation: All candidates on existing phase-6 validation (32 windows) and audit (64 windows, 32 documents), context 128. These are previously used sets, not a fresh test. Audit never selects masks, gradients or variants in this study.
metrics: Next-token NLL, teacher KL, perplexity ratio to original 30-block model, paired document bootstrap. Recovery fraction is initial-minus-masked NLL divided by initial-minus-full-update NLL at the same depth.
scope: Post-hoc sufficiency/intervention study. No fresh sparse-model training and no training-cost saving claim. All masked updates are derived from a fully trained checkpoint; this uses its information.
limits: Weight frequency depends on tensor ordering
Large Fourier magnitude does not imply functional importance
No power-spectrum comparison can recover phase information
